title: New Balance 990v4 Made in USA "NB Navy/Meteorite": a premium construction designed for Fall 2026

content:
New Balance is gearing up for its Fall/Winter 2026 Made in USA collection with a new series of premium silhouettes. Alongside the 993 "Morel," the Boston-based brand is unveiling an unusual interpretation of the 990v4, dressed in a blend of navy blue and dark green.

Dubbed "NB Navy/Meteorite" , this new version is distinguished above all by its choice of materials, with New Balance partly abandoning the traditional suede of the 990v4 in favor of a construction more suited to cold seasons.

The 990v4 changes materials

The New Balance 990v4 Made in USA is typically associated with a combination of mesh and soft suede. For this new edition, the brand significantly alters the formula with the use of leather and nubuck.

A relatively rare choice on the 990v4, but not entirely unfamiliar to Made in USA collections. New Balance has already used this type of material combination on some of its fall and winter offerings.

The silhouette nevertheless retains its mesh base, preserving the technical and running identity characteristic of the 990v4.

A palette of NB Navy and Meteorite

In terms of colours, New Balance is opting for a particularly understated approach.

The mesh base, the various inserts and the sole adopt a dominant NB Navy color, giving the sneaker an almost monochrome appearance.

Touches of Meteorite , a very dark green, appear on some underlayers and create a subtle contrast with the navy blue.

Rather than multiplying colours, New Balance plays here on nuances, textures and differences in materials to give more depth to the silhouette.

A 990v4 designed for cold weather.

This combination of leather, nubuck and dark tones naturally places the pair within New Balance's Fall/Winter 2026 universe.

The approach is quite different from the traditional grey colours that have contributed to the reputation of the 990 family. This "NB Navy/Meteorite" retains the characteristic sobriety of the Made in USA program while offering a darker and seasonal aesthetic.

The premium construction also highlights the many overlays that make up the 990v4, a silhouette originally launched as a performance running shoe before gradually becoming a New Balance lifestyle staple.

Made in USA continues its exploration of the 990

With this new 990v4, New Balance continues to use its Made in USA program as a testing ground for its historical models.

The modifications remain subtle: no radical transformation of the silhouette, but a work on materials, textures and colors that allows for a different interpretation of the model.

The "NB Navy/Meteorite" thus accompanies the New Balance 993 "Morel" in the new seasonal Made in USA selection planned for autumn-winter 2026.

Release date: September 24, 2026

The New Balance 990v4 Made in USA “NB Navy/Meteorite” will be released on September 24, 2026.

Listed under the SKU U990BG4 , it will be offered at a price of $195.

With its navy blue and dark green palette and above all its unusual construction mixing leather, nubuck and mesh, this new 990v4 offers a decidedly autumnal interpretation of a Made in USA classic, while maintaining the balance between running heritage and premium manufacturing that characterizes the line.
